2. What spiritual activities would you like to do on an ongoing basis?

---

The word ‘spirituality’ has different meanings for different people. It may mean getting out into
nature, dancing, meditating, practising yoga or participating in an organised religion. Whatever it
means to you is fine.

generation_rules: Use open-ended questions to explore desired activities and values
Encourage identification of specific behaviors to increase or resume
pause_rules: Allow time for reflection after each question to facilitate thoughtful responses
original_extraction.psychological_function: Encouraging values clarification and commitment to personally significant behaviors
repetition_rules: Repeat question formats to cover different life domains (fun, spirituality, community, nature, health)
original_extraction.therapeutic_function: Facilitating engagement in meaningful activities to enhance well-being and life satisfaction
voice_rules: Normalize diverse meanings of spirituality and activities
